parameters.name: AllowShutDown
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable no-activity suspension. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables the feature.

- **false** (default): Disables the feature.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the task. Use the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: ScaleApRoNumMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: ScaleApRoNumMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: ScaleMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of PCUs. The value must be from 1 to 32.

parameters.name: ScaleMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of PolarDB Capacity Units (PCUs). The value must be from 0.25 to 32 and must be less than or equal to the value of ScaleMax.

parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of read-only nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15. The value must be greater than or equal to the value of ScaleRoNumMin.

parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of read-only nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: SecondsUntilAutoPause
parameters.description: The period of inactivity in minutes before the cluster is automatically paused. The value must be a multiple of 5 and range from 5 to 1440.

parameters.name: ServerlessRuleCpuEnlargeThreshold
parameters.description: The CPU utilization percentage that triggers a scale-up. Valid values: 40 to 100.

parameters.name: ServerlessRuleCpuShrinkThreshold
parameters.description: The CPU utilization percentage that triggers a scale-down. Valid values: 10 to 100. The value of ServerlessRuleCpuEnlargeThreshold minus the value of this parameter must be 30 or greater.

parameters.name: ServerlessRuleMode
parameters.description:
The scaling sensitivity. Valid values:

- normal: standard

- flexible: flexible

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the task. Use the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
